verdict.rationale: Vanta explicitly markets AI-generated insights inside the product: the Vanta AI Agent drafts policies, completes questionnaires, and flags issues; Vanta AI reviews evidence, flags gaps, and suggests fixes; and questionnaire automation generates responses from a knowledge base. These are first-party product features (not just API/MCP access), directly matching the story of receiving AI-generated insights/suggestions from data in-product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of AI insight quality and no third-party review confirming accuracy of these suggestions.
